explorer.description: Analisis project tanpa mengubah kode — membaca struktur, framework, route, dependency, dan business flow

planner.description: Mengubah request menjadi implementation plan — impact analysis, task decomposition, risk assessment, rollback strategy

implementer.description: Menghasilkan kode production-ready berdasarkan implementation plan — mengikuti existing pattern, backward compatible

reviewer.description: Audit implementasi — correctness, security, performance, consistency, backward compatibility, duplicate logic

documenter.description: Membuat dan memperbarui dokumentasi project — SYSTEM_MAP, API_MAP, CHANGELOG, README, cross-reference validation
